levels.name: Recognise
levels.evidence: Learner can identify what food contains in the chapter context.

levels.name: Explain
levels.evidence: Learner can explain what food contains and connect it to balanced meals without copying source wording.

levels.name: Apply
levels.evidence: Learner can use food preservation in a familiar new situation.

levels.name: Transfer
levels.evidence: Learner can solve or explain an unfamiliar situation using several ideas from The Mystery of Food and justify the response.

levels.name: Create
levels.evidence: Learner can create a new example, question, model, investigation or explanation based on The Mystery of Food.

progressionRule: Move upward only when the learner demonstrates the current level independently and can explain the reasoning.

_gurukulChapterContext.subject: EVS
_gurukulChapterContext.contentPolicy: Gurukul-original enrichment grounded in the supplied NCERT chapter; no verbatim textbook prose.
